summary.intent: Fix two onboarding bugs on the `cli-onboard` branch (a stale '✗ History' status after import, and a misleading web-UI promise message) after merging in main.
summary.outcome: Merged origin/main into cli-onboard, fixed both onboarding bugs plus a bonus Go 1.26 test flakiness issue, and confirmed `mise run check` passes fully; changes committed but left unpushed.

repo: The checkpoint layer has two coexisting backends (entire/checkpoints/v1 branch tip vs git-refs primary at refs/entire/checkpoints/<shard>/<id>); any cache keyed only on the v1 branch tip goes silently stale when a repo is configured to use git-refs, since imports there never move the v1 branch.
The import rung's memoized scan cache fingerprint must include an order-independent digest of per-checkpoint refs, not just the v1 branch tip, to correctly invalidate after a git-refs import.

onboardingSetupSummary previously appended a generic 'so your work shows up in the web UI' clause to all missing steps including import, which was factually wrong for import (which surfaces past sessions in the CLI's session list, not the web UI).

code.finding: Under Go 1.26, `go test -json` (used by gotestsum/mise run test) swaps the os.Stderr variable after package init, breaking a pointer-equality assertion that passes fine under plain `go test`. Fixed by pinning the test to compare by file descriptor instead of pointer identity.

workflow: 'Passes with `go test` but fails with `mise run test`' is a recognizable signature of the Go 1.26 os.Stderr swap under -json mode, not a flake — worth checking directly rather than re-running.

When merging main into a long-lived branch with overlapping onboarding/setup logic, resolve conflicts by preserving both sides' distinct fixes (e.g. kept main's `useProject` scope fix and branch's onboarding hook in setup.go) rather than picking one side wholesale.

friction: Merge conflict in setup.go required manually reconciling main's useProject scope fix with the branch's onboarding hook changes.

An unrelated pre-existing test failure (tokenstore stderr pointer assertion) surfaced only after merging main and only under the -json test runner, requiring extra investigation to distinguish it from a regression caused by the merge.
open_items: Branch cli-onboard has all fixes committed but is not yet pushed to update the PR/trail — awaiting user confirmation to push.
